standard_interpretation.primary: The latest wording forbids dependence on the released evaluator label but does not expressly exclude all component evaluator outputs that can reconstruct it.
standard_interpretation.strict_sensitivity_result: 0/68 pass when released-label-equivalent component outputs are also excluded

outcome_free_drafting.finding: The sealed drafting input contained only draft instructions, template, case packet, and output schema; the canonical freeze records no benchmark-run or score-output exposure.

formal_lock.finding: YAML and JSON are byte-identical to the pre-benchmark/pre-score canonical freeze for 68/68 cases, but the newly pulled results directory has no independent formal freeze.

native_semantics.finding: All released evaluator registered-test blocks are represented and non-scoring TestTracker attributes are excluded.

native_sfu_composition.finding: Each checklist has per-test success/failure and an undecided rule, but none explicitly freezes the aggregate formula all-pass=>S, any-established-fail=>F, otherwise=>U.
native_sfu_composition.required_change: Add the exact three-valued aggregate rule without changing the native criterion.

direct_released_label_dependency.finding: The checklists contain no per-record released label, native label, native score, agent outcome, or conflict conclusion.

testtracker_component_results.finding: All checklists list official TestTracker results as decisive evidence. The latest wording does not expressly exclude them, although they deterministically reconstruct the released result.

present_condition_findings.reason: Exact import is source-supported, but the referenced predeclared newline canonicalization is not declared.
The condition over-scopes the source-supported 15-minute playback path and does not bind start-state downloads or current/cursor state.
Expense total is a source value while each share is derived; the formula and cent rounding must be frozen separately.
Scope to task-added records and cover both Transaction and PaymentRequest privacy, amount, description, and source-obligation cardinality.
Every retained is overbroad; scope the condition to task-added records bound to each CSV row.
The task supports preservation of semantic mappings, not byte identity or fixed row order.
A reverse permutation can be a valid shuffle; retained API/trace evidence should establish that shuffle occurred and produced the final queue.
Credential equality is task-supported, but a post-hoc probe and no-retained-credential rule are evidence-governance choices rather than task outcomes.
The task supports identical moved tasks, but the condition does not enumerate schema-bound equal fields, permitted differences, or the record bijection.
Whole-message name-only equality is supported, but raw case and spacing policy must be predeclared rather than inferred.
The condition lacks official outcome support and conflicts with the task-supported refill path.
The official task does not require the relative order of retained songs; this is a reviewer-imposed stability preference.

missing_stronger_findings.reason: Source messages enumerate individual add/remove actions while evaluator set comparison loses multiplicity.
The source specifies the new playlist songs while evaluator set comparison loses duplicates; the condition should remain scoped to that new playlist.
Each source expense has a description that the evaluator does not check.
The task requires requests to be private and carry the Maui-trip description, but evaluator omits those request fields.
Source obligations are one-to-one while receiver-keyed evaluator dictionaries can collapse duplicates.
The unique source list supports one occurrence per source song while evaluator set comparison permits duplicate additions.
The task requires one branch per CSV person while evaluator dictionaries can collapse duplicate activities.
The task requires the same case-sensitive credential in the account and SMS while evaluator uses ignore-case for the SMS.
The task explicitly quotes the original-title separator format while evaluator normalizes title text.
The task explicitly quotes the first header token as lowercase date while evaluator compares headers with ignore-case.

direct_label_input_isolation.finding: The reference scorer copies the entire evidence directory to the model workspace and only guards decisive pointers to selected summary fields.

post_score_comparison.finding: Only released success versus native non-S is flagged; released fail versus native non-F and a unified U review path are absent.

confirmed_benchmark_conflict_workflow.finding: No independent AppWorld/reference schema and runner was found that requires retained-artifact and source-pointer proof of task/target/evaluator/oracle/reward-wiring outcome mismatch.

stronger_separation.finding: Stronger is separately reported; the native-S/stronger-F audit flag is not a confirmed conflict.

recommended_actions: Do not overwrite old frozen checklists; version source-only corrections for the 27 action cases.
Freeze an explicit native three-valued aggregation rule for all AppWorld cases.
Choose and state either direct-label-only blinding or released-result-equivalent-output blinding.
Build and hash a sanitized scorer view while retaining the full benchmark bundle unchanged.
Implement symmetric post-score mismatch routing and a separate source-pointer-based confirmed-conflict adjudication workflow.
